# Rafiq v0.5.11: lighter on your computer, quicker at work

A release about performance. On a laptop with built-in graphics, Rafiq used to keep its
heavy parts (the motion engine, 3D, the globe behind the pages) busy even when you weren't
using them. Now it runs only what you have open.

---

## ⚡ Only what you open runs

- **Pages load when you open them:** Motion, the creative studio, design and notes are no
  longer part of what loads at startup. The code loaded when the app opens went from
  2.8 MB to 1.3 MB.
- **The motion engine lives inside the project:** it starts when you open a motion project
  (a short «Starting the motion engine…» while it does) and stops when you leave it. Outside
  a project, the model checks a reel's structure and asks you to open it to measure frames.
- **Motion cards show a still** of the reel, saved the first time you open the project,
  instead of running a player each.
- **Design previews run only while they're on screen**, in the chat and in the designs list.
- **Settings → Motion** shows its preview only when you ask for it.

## 🌍 Quicker between pages

- The globe behind the pages is **built once**: pages that cover it only hide it, so moving
  between pages no longer creates a new graphics context each time (and the old one is
  released right away).
- It draws at **30 frames a second and one pixel per screen point**: its graphics work went
  from 19% to 8% on the development machine.
- After you switch pages it **waits a moment**, so the new page draws first.
- Where the window has no graphics card (software drawing), it **stands still**.
- It stops drawing while Rafiq is in the background.

## 🎬 Motion doesn't freeze

- The engine gives the window room while it checks a reel, so the app stays responsive.
- One engine stays up between the model's checks instead of starting over each time.
- Every 3D preview shares one graphics context.

## 🛠 Quicker, cheaper tasks

- **Edit part of a file:** a new tool replaces just the text that changes instead of
  rewriting the whole file.
- **Scripts instead of one-liners:** the model sends Python, PowerShell or Node code as a
  script, which runs from a file with UTF-8 set up, so Arabic text no longer breaks it
  (no more `UnicodeEncodeError` or quoting errors from `cmd`).
- **Long tasks keep their context small:** older tool results are condensed as a task goes
  on, so long tasks use fewer tokens.
- A script that deletes files needs a press-and-hold, like a risky command.

## 🔧 Fixed

- The glowing orb could stay stuck above a reply.
- The What's new video lets go of its memory when the dialog closes.

---

**Updating:** installed copies offer this update on their own. For a new install, download
`Rafiq_0.5.11_x64-setup.exe` below and check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Rafiq_0.5.11_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```
